subject: general
question: Anil works 3 times faster than Sandeep. If Sandeep can complete work independently in 12 days, the number of days in which Anil and Sandeep can together finish the work is:
solution:
Given: 

Anil works 3 times faster than Sandeep.

Sandeep can complete a work independently in 12 days.

Concept used: 

Number of Day = Total work/work complete per day

Calculation: 

According to question,

Sandeep completes work in 12 days.

So, Anil complete the the work in 12/3 = 4 days

Now, One day work of both anil and Sandeep together is

= 1/12 + 1/4

= ((1+3))/(12)

= (1)/(3)

Now,

Time taken by Anil and Sandeep both together to complete the work 

⇒ 3 days

∴ The time taken by both Anil and Sandeep together to complete the work is 3 days.
